title: 1. No Budget
text: Spending money without planning can make it difficult to know where your money is going.

title: 2. Impulse Buying
text: Buying things you don't need can quickly reduce your savings.

title: 3. Ignoring Small Expenses
text: Small daily expenses may seem harmless, but they can add up over time.

title: 4. Not Saving
text: Waiting until the end of the month to save can make building savings difficult.

title: 5. Unnecessary Debt
text: Borrowing money for things you don't really need can create financial pressure.

title: 6. No Emergency Fund
text: Unexpected expenses can become stressful when you have no emergency savings.

title: 7. Living Beyond Income
text: Spending more than you earn can make it harder to reach your financial goals.

title: 8. No Financial Goals
text: Without clear goals, it becomes harder to stay motivated and manage your money effectively.
